aggregateRecipe: SHA-256 over sorted UTF-8 lines: repository-relative-path + NUL + file-SHA-256 + LF
sealedTextSetAggregateRecipe: SEAL MANIFEST candidate v6 (awaiting owner manifest verification and release). Aggregate = SHA-256 of the UTF-8 text of lines '<locale> <corpus-json-sha256> <items>' sorted by locale, newline-joined with a trailing newline.
sealedTextSetEquivalence: Importer output texts and fields are identical, in order, to the sealed per-locale corpus JSON (FINAL-v6/holdout-v6-<locale>.json, coordinator-verified aggregate ade26a6cab7213bf647dbebdec5f60922cbefd96ef0a9bed7fe488f5f09d73b4); importer IDs are <locale>-holdout-v6-001..2000 in the same order as sealed IDs <locale>-holdout-v6-0001..2000.
construction: 14000 complete items individually composed and persisted literally by authors; no banks, templates, combinatorial assembly or text-generating program. Tools copy complete items unchanged and measure them. Seven locales x 2000 (1000 captions, 1000 altTexts).
sixLocaleNote: This directory holds de, en, es, fr, it and tr only. The Portuguese v6 file is not part of it: PT v6 failed its evaluation (16 of 2000, later 10 of 2000 on the round 7 policy), is spent and is retired for pt in the ledger. corpusSha256 aggregates these six listed files. The seven-locale sealed text-set aggregate ade26a6c above is the original seal record and is unchanged; its per-locale corpus JSON hashes remain in FINAL-v6/SEAL-MANIFEST.json. The six files are the bytes released and first evaluated, with the allow-list and term pins they were frozen against before repair inspection; a re-import on the current policy yields identical entries and newer pins, so the sealed bytes are kept.
